[Discussion] Any good games with bad legacy?
Basically, making its sequels and games inspired by it not good. Maybe because what they tried to imitate didn't work for an example.

These days I'm hard pressed to think of games with a good legacy. Seems to take fewer and fewer iterations for games to get driven into the ground. We're lucky if the 3rd one is any good. Ultima made it to 7 before things started to go sideways.

Sonic is ran into the ground.

Assassin's Creed seems to still be suffering from what Unity inflicted on it's reputation.

Doom 3 sullied 1 & 2's reputation with monster closets and a lack of duct tape.

Diablo 3 shat on Diablo 2 hard, and despite everything Blizzard has done to turn that game around, most people still think the game has connection issues and a terrible end game.

This is a hard topic because game sequels and post-inspiration can be radically different games.

I'd love to say "Sonic" but I don't think I can really compare today's 3D games to the 2D games of yesteryear, even if the 3D games were good, simply because the change in perspective and mechanisms makes it an entirely different game played completely differently. Thankfully I don't necessarily have to talk about gameplay: the Sonic universe is bloated with fanservice in the form of hundreds of important characters and retcon lore and I'd definitely call it a bad legacy.
